question: A can complete a work in 5 days and B can complete the same work in 10 days. If A and B work alternately, starting with A, in how many days will they complete the work?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

A completes the work = 5 days

B completes the work = 10 days

A and B work alternately

**CALCULATION:**

Complete the work in 5 days

⇒ A's 1 day work = 1/5 

B complete the work in 10 days

⇒ B's 1 day work = 1/10

⇒ ( A + B )'s work in 2 days = ( 1/5 + 1/10)= 3/10 

In 3 pairs of 2 days they will complete 3/10 × 3 = 9/10

⇒ Hence, after 3 × 2 = 6 days, 1 - 9/10 = 1/10 work is left which will be done by A alone.

⇒ A does 1 work in 5 days 

⇒ A does 1/10 work in 5 × 1/10 = 1/2 days

⇒ Total number of days = 6 + 1/2 = 6 1over 2days

**Hence, they will complete the work in 6 1over 2 days.**
